ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Bitget Live is rolling out a new streamer rewards program! New streamers get double commission, traffic boosts and stream bonuses. All streamers earn base commission and can climb the biweekly leaderboards for fixed prizes. Streamers who don't make the leaderboard can still share a guaranteed reward pool.
The first series Event period: 2026-11-25 00:00 – 2026-12-08 23:59 (UTC+8)
How to join: Apply to become a Bitget Live streamer here: [
Application link]
## Key definitions
New streamer: A streamer within 28 days of their first stream, including the day of the first stream
Valid stream: A stream lasting at least 60 minutes with at least one trade over 10 USDT, a saved replay, and no idle streaming, pre-recorded content, low-quality content or batch-operated accounts
Live-room trading volume: Trades completed within 1 hour after a viewer taps a token tag in your live room
## Program 1: New Streamer Welcome Pack (first 28 days)
## 1. Double commission
Earn 20% commission on attributed trading fees during your first 28 days, double the standard 10%.
## 2. Traffic boost
Hit any of the milestones below to receive 3 official promotions for your streams:

First 3 days | ≥ 2 days | ≥ 500 USDT | ≥ 30
First 7 days | ≥ 5 days | ≥ 1,000 USDT | ≥ 50

## 3. Stream bonus
Valid streams completed | Bonus
3 streams | 2 USDT

Streams 7–10 | 3 USDT per stream
Complete 10 valid streams in your first 28 days to earn up to 20 USDT.

All valid streamers earn
10% of the trading fees attributed to their live room (20% for new streamers).
## Program 3: Biweekly Leaderboards
Eligibility: Complete at least 6 valid streams in the period.
Streamers are ranked by live-room trading volume over the 2-week period. Crypto & Stocks and CFD are ranked separately, and you can win on both leaderboards. The leaderboard is updated daily on web

## Reward rules
To claim a tier's reward, you must rank within that tier and meet its minimum volume
If you rank within a tier but miss its minimum volume, you'll receive the highest tier your volume qualifies for. Each tier has a fixed number of spots, filled in ranking order; once a tier is full, you move to the next one
Each streamer can claim only one tier per leaderboard per period
## Program 4: Guaranteed Reward Pool
Valid streamers who don't win a leaderboard prize can share the guaranteed reward pool. The more valid streams all streamers complete together, the bigger the pool.
Eligibility: At least 3 valid streams every week during the period
Level | Total valid streams by all eligible streamers | Reward per streamer
Level 1 | ≥ 75 | 4 USDT (up to 40 streamers)
Level 2 | ≥ 85 | 6 USDT (up to 50 streamers)

If more streamers qualify than there are spots, rewards will go to streamers in order of overall performance, including stream quality, trading volume and viewers, until the pool runs out.

Headline: Agent ID Hackathon: Build Decentralized Applications (dApps) Around Agent ID to Win 60,000 USDC Worth of Rewards

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance Wallet, together with BNB Chain, is jointly hosting the Agent ID Hackathon. Developers may participate and explore innovative use cases for Agent ID in on-chain applications. Agent ID is the on-chain name of an Agentic Wallet, taking the form of name.ai. Each user can claim only one Agent ID, and it is non-transferable. Participating projects must be deployed on BNB Chain and actively use Agent ID. Both new and existing projects are eligible to submit.
Submission Period: 2026-11-18 08:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-09 08:00 (UTC)
Internal Review Period: 2026-12-09 08:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-17 08:00 (UTC)
Public Review Period: 2026-12-17 08:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-20 08:00 (UTC)
Submit Project Now
## How to Participate
Refine your ideas and deploy your contract(s) on BNB Chain, complete source code verification on BscScan, and make the code publicly open-source.
Integrate Agent ID into your product for real-world use cases, such as access control, payments, and identity.
Submit your project name, website, contract address(es), Agent ID usage description, and other required materials during the Submission Period. No registration needed.
During the Submission Period, actively guide Agent ID holders to interact with your project contract(s).
## Eligibility
Open to all Binance Wallet users, developers, and project teams. Individuals and teams may both participate.
New and existing projects are eligible. For existing projects, only data generated during the Submission Period will be counted; historical data prior to the campaign is excluded.
Participating projects must actively use Agent ID.
Participating projects must have deployed smart contracts on BNB Chain with source code verified and open-sourced on BscScan.
Must not violate any of the safety red lines set out in these rules.
## Reward Structure

Participating projects must comply with the following safety red lines. Violation of any of the following will result in immediate disqualification:
No web-based QR code login for Agentic Wallet. Projects must not allow users to scan QR codes or enter pairing codes on third-party websites to sign in, nor store users' login sessions on servers to place orders on users' behalf.

No collection of sensitive credentials. Projects must not collect users' seed phrases, private keys, API secrets, or pairing codes.
Participating projects must not promise returns externally. Terms such as "passive income" or "automatic money-making" are prohibited.
Products involving trading must display risk warnings on the page.
Agent ID must not be packaged as a tool for "looking up other people's wallets by name."

## About Agent OS
Binance Agent OS is a developer platform under the Binance Intelligence architecture that connects compatible AI applications and Agents to Binance-supported features through user-controllable permissions.
Binance Agent OS integrates Binance APIs, Binance Wallet Agentic Hub, Binance x402, Binance Skill Hub, and support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) into a more cohesive ecosystem serving developers, users, and the broader industry. This release reflects Binance's commitment to building infrastructure for agentic crypto experiences and lays the foundation for continued expansion of agentic skills, wallet capabilities, and developer tools.
